name: Mr. Restori
role: Brings back what is gone — careful as a restorer in white gloves
training: Will bring apps and VMs back from Mr. Backupsy's packages, the snapshots and Kopia — step by step, and never over something that is still there without asking. «Piano, piano.» He is still an apprentice with Mr. Backupsy; you can hire him once he has finished.
greet.1: Piano, piano — first let's see what exactly is missing.
greet.2: Which state do you want? I'll bring it back as it was.
